jobs.title: Desarollador/a full stack
jobs.description:
Para algunas personas, la tecnología es un reto. Para otras, una oportunidad para transformar la manera en que las empresas trabajan y crecen.
En Integra
no solo compartimos esa visión: la impulsamos cada día.
Somos una consultora tecnológica que ofrece soluciones globales a necesidades complejas desde otro punto de vista. Escuchamos para crear progreso, integrando tecnología, experiencia y cercanía.
Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack especializado/a en Angular y .NET
para participar en el desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas modernas, escalables y orientadas a aportar valor real.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Diseñar y desarrollar aplicaciones frontend con Angular 16+ y TypeScript
, trabajando con Standalone Components, RxJS y NgRx.
Desarrollar servicios backend con .NET 8+
bajo arquitecturas de microservicios.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener APIs REST
.
Trabajar con Entity Framework Core y PostgreSQL
para la gestión y persistencia de datos.
Aplicar patrones como CQRS con MediatR
o soluciones equivalentes.
Desarrollar y mantener tests unitarios en backend
, contribuyendo a garantizar la calidad y estabilidad de las soluciones.
Colaborar con el resto del equipo en el diseño técnico y evolución de los proyectos.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Al menos 4 años de experiencia profesional
en desarrollo de software.
Experiencia sólida con Angular 16+, TypeScript, Standalone Components, RxJS y NgRx
.
Experiencia con .NET 8+
y arquitecturas basadas en microservicios.
Conocimiento en diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST
.
Experiencia trabajando con Entity Framework Core y PostgreSQL
.
Conocimiento y experiencia aplicando CQRS con MediatR
o patrones equivalentes.
Experiencia desarrollando tests unitarios en backend
.
Inglés C1.

Además, valoraremos especialmente si tienes experiencia con:

Arquitecturas de micro frontends
, utilizando Module Federation o Native Federation.
Entornos monorepo con Nx
.
Docker
, incluyendo creación y mantenimiento de Dockerfiles y docker-compose.
Lectura y comprensión de manifiestos de Kubernetes y Helm
.
Desarrollo y mantenimiento de suites de tests E2E con Cypress
.
Trabajo previo con un Design System
.

¿Por qué Integra?

En Integra, creemos en las personas
.
Aquí se trabaja en equipo, se escucha, se propone, se mejora y se comparte
.
Nos mueve la innovación con sentido
, y la tecnología con impacto
.
Porque para nosotros, integrar no es solo unir sistemas: es construir algo juntos
.
Porque trabajamos con propósito, y eso se nota.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI  (Spain)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The base wage range for this position based in Spain is 111,000-143,000 EUR.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 
For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks . 
Diversity At Justworks
Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

The Software Engineer will be responsible for developing high-quality applications. They will also be responsible for designing and implementing testable and scalable code.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop quality software and web applications
Analyze and maintain existing software applications
Design highly scalable, testable code
Discover and fix programming bugs
Write efficient, scalable, and well-designed code using core Java and enterprise frameworks.
Design and build secure RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Perform unit and integration testing, troubleshoot issues, and execute code reviews.
Work with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases or caching layers (Redis).
Containerize applications using Docker and deploy them via Kubernetes or cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP

Key Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field
0-2 years experience development experience with programming languages
Strong proficiency in Java and Object-Oriented Design (OOD)
SQL database or relational database skills
Experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot, Spring MVC, or Hibernate.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and testing tools (JUnit, Mockito).
Strong problem-solving abilities, clear communication, and teamwork in an Agile/Scrum environment
